method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: Dead left half; a tangle with no single read of the rod.
notes.fix: Rod and stuffing box right of centre filling the lower two thirds, rimmed from behind, ladder out of the near plane.

notes.problem: Untextured primitives, dead left half, footer on the column.
notes.fix: Camera about 0.6 m right and lower; a hard work light on the rod; grime on the tee and flanges; keep the column off the footer.

notes.problem: Primitive wellhead and a ladder as the most legible object; bar, bridle and rod highlight don't read; empty left.
notes.fix: Camera about 1 m left and closer so the rod and bar run full height through the centre right with one rim; crop the ladder out.

notes.problem: Coin pictograms in a straight-on grid; lit scrub behind.
notes.fix: Camera about 25 degrees off axis at 1.0 m, worn steel joints, delete the scrub.

notes.problem: Flat white rings read as a dot chart; flat stands; a moire object; empty bottom.
notes.fix: Bevelled tool joints with worn faces and a key rim; camera to about 1.0 m pushed in; delete the background object.

notes.problem: Flat white rings, stack overhang, untextured stands, blobs behind.
notes.fix: Bevelled tool-joint lips in dark worn steel, stacks centred on racks, background props deleted.

notes.problem: Square bars; flat tag; a two-bar chart.
notes.fix: Semicircular height profile, round couplings with flats, lit brass tag on a wire with a cast.

notes.problem: Stepped two-tone rods, square couplings, flat tag, dead band.
notes.fix: Round height field with a specular; round couplings with flats; raised brass tag with a cast; rods up about 150 px.

notes.problem: A bar chart of two flat rods; a flat tag.
notes.fix: Round profile with a specular streak; lit brass tag wired to the coupling.
Key about 15 degrees toward camera or a rim behind the beam.

notes.problem: Cover jack near-pure black; only the plastic crank lit.
notes.fix: A warm back rim at 10 to 20 degrees opposite the camera; worn paint on the crank.

notes.problem: Silhouette without rim; the pale crank is the brightest shape.
notes.fix: Narrow rim key behind the jack; crank exposure below the beam's.

notes.problem: A flat grey slab with stamped bars.
notes.fix: Raise the curl and clip, a fibre bump, a lower key for long casts, near-white paper on black steel.

notes.problem: Mid-grey page, flat curl shadow, box clip.
notes.fix: Raking pool to near white at the edge; a curl with real height; a wire clip.

notes.problem: Periodic corrugated stripes; a small jack.
notes.fix: Noise bedding; camera in so the jack stands at least 200 px.

notes.problem: Corrugated ribbing; small black jack; long leaders.
notes.fix: Noise bedding; camera in about 30 percent; shorter leaders.

notes.problem: Mid-tone olive frame, flat plank and target, cropped base.
notes.fix: Darker tank albedo with one raking edge; camera up so the wall and contact enter; a lit enamel float casting on the board.
Move the worker into the gate opening, backlit, lower its contrast.
